Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.  Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você . Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as  Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Technical Product Owner em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‐drivenTechnical Product Ownerto serve as the "engine room" of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‐level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‐native, AI‐driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the "Golden Record" through seamless end‐to‐end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.What You'll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‐class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‐functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define "What Good Looks Like." Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‐world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance "plumbing." Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‐zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.Key Skills Visionary Leadership:Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts:Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application:Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‐matching or data‐cleansing logic. Visual Communication:Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding:Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration:Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results:Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‐moving environment.Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big- Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have. Be Curious- Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action- Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together- Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone's work is seen, and ideas are valued.OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);  plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;  proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS). Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurançaAntes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Informações da vaga:Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: -  Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;   -  Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;   -  Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;   -  Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;   -  Planejem e executem otrabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;   -  Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!Saúde e Bem-estar:  -  Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;   -  Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;   -  Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;   -  Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;   -  Vale-Refeição;  - Vale-Transporte;   -  Auxílio-Creche;  -  Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.Desenvolvimento e educação:  -  Plataforma de ensino; description:

Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!Inscreva-se pelo formulário:

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;  the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;  the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;  the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;  quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

description:

Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Improve system reliability through automation and observability.Qualifications Required Qualifications:The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.G., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing.Desired Qualifications:The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position.This role starts at R$10,000 per month

title: Ai Evaluation Engineer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Ai Evaluation Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About FirstIgnite FirstIgnite is the AI-powered business development platform for university technology transfer offices (TTOs). We help research institutions turn breakthroughs into partnerships, licenses, and companies by combining deep LLM-driven workflows with the relationships that actually move deals forward. Our product suite spans expert discovery, grants search, and AI-driven outreach — all built on a modern, agentic stack. We ship fast, we measure everything, and we believe evaluations are the difference between AI features that demo well and AI features that work in production.The Role We're hiring an AI Evaluation Engineer to own the quality bar for every LLM-powered feature we ship. You'll design, build, and scale the infrastructure that tells us — with evidence — whether a prompt change, model swap, or agent refactor made things better or worse. This is a high-leverage role. Every customer-facing AI capability at FirstIgnite flows through your evals. You'll work directly with the Head of Engineering and partner closely with product, applied AI, and the full-stack team to establish evaluation as a first-class discipline across the company.What You'll Do Build evaluation infrastructure: Design and maintain eval suites using Promptfoo, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and custom harnesses for features like our expert search system, natural language grants search, and AI SDR agents. Define what 'good' means: Partner with product and domain experts to translate fuzzy customer outcomes (\ "does this surface the right principal investigator?\ ") into precise, measurable rubrics. Own the feedback loop: Instrument production traffic, curate golden datasets from real customer interactions, and build pipelines that turn user behavior into regression tests. Ship quickly under uncertainty: We routinely run 48-hour eval sprints for greenfield features with no production traffic. You'll be comfortable bootstrapping quality signal from scratch. Model and prompt evaluation: Run rigorous A/B comparisons across models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-weight), prompt strategies, and agent architectures. Quantify tradeoffs between cost, latency, and quality. Agent evaluation: Help us measure multi-step agent behavior built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, Vercel AI SDK, and Temporal Cloud — including tool-use correctness, trajectory quality, and end-to-end task completion. Raise the floor for the team: Create templates, documentation, and tooling so every engineer can write and run evals as part of normal development. Evals should feel as natural as unit tests.Requirements 3+ years of engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on LLM/ML evaluation, applied AI, or data quality systems. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks — Promptfoo, Braintrust, LangSmith, OpenAI Evals, DeepEval, or equivalent in-house tooling. Strong grasp of LLM-as-judge methodology, including its failure modes (position bias, verbosity bias, judge-model drift) and how to mitigate them. Statistical literacy — you know the difference between a real regression and noise, and you can design experiments that answer the question actually being asked. Product instincts. You can sit with a customer success call transcript, identify the three failure modes that matter, and ship an eval for each by end of week. Strong written communication. Evals are useless if the engineers shipping features don't trust or read the results.Preferred Qualifications Experience evaluating retrieval systems (RAG, hybrid search, reranking) — especially over structured or semi-structured domains like research, grants, or patents. Exposure to agent orchestration frameworks (Temporal, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK) and the specific challenges of evaluating multi-step, tool-using systems. Background in information retrieval, search relevance, or a research-adjacent domain. Experience building internal tooling or dashboards that non-engineers (PMs, domain experts) actually use to label and review model outputs.Why This Role You'll be the first dedicated evals hire. The scope, standards, and tooling are yours to define. AI quality is existential for our product. This isn't a compliance role tucked into a corner — it's directly on the critical path to revenue. Small, senior team. ~10 engineers, distributed globally, with a strong bias toward shipping and measuring. Direct access to real-world, high-stakes LLM use cases — research discovery, grants, outbound — across a customer base that deeply values accuracy.As part of your LinkedIn application submission, please use Loom to record a video and email it to us within the next 48 hours, along with your resume and Linkedin profile link. The recording should include both your camera (showing yourself) and your screen as you walk us through a project or piece of code you're proud of.Please email the video towith the title of the position you are applying for in the subject line. We look forward to your submission!

Nosso objetivo é conectar fãs e compartilhar as últimas novidades por meio de resenhas, análises e notícias exclusivas. Com uma equipe dinâmica e apaixonada, buscamos inspirar e engajar nossa audiência no Brasil e além. As principais responsabilidades incluem criação e edição de conteúdos, gestão das redes sociais, planejamento de publicações e interação com a comunidade de seguidores. description:

Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we're not just building products, we're pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.Innovate with Tether Tether Finance:Our innovative product suite features the world's most trusted stablecoin,USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that's just the beginning: Tether Power:Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data:Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions likeKEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you're passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We've grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future?About the job As a senior Frontend Developer, you will be a part of the team that works on the development and maintenance of the frontend components of multiple applications related to the platform. This includes: New Products and Features- Tether continuously strives to create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional experience for customers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies, to ensure the user experience remains the best in the industry. Performance- all ui components that power Tether platform must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Security- Tether makes Security its most important feature. The Frontend Development team is responsible for building all the interactions with API services with the highest security principles and standard, in order to protect the safety of the entire user base.Responsibilities Collaborate with the team to work on the development of the Bitfinex KYC webapps. Including: New Features: Create innovative new features in order to provide the most professional KYC experience for customers and compliance officers. These are developed and deployed using agile methodologies. Scalability: The web application must remain effortlessly smooth, responsive, and real-time for customers as the platform continues to scale to accommodate new user growth. Design: Build beautiful reactive applications and trading tools. Domain knowledge: willing to learn the domain-related logic and condition-based logic, including the one based on difference between multiple users scenarios and combinations of factors Debugging: Being able to debug hidden/hard to find issues when needed, advanced usage of browser debugging tools, including network, source, stop points etc.Requirements With 5+ years of proven experience in software development, with a strong focus on Frontend. Knowledgeable and experienced with micro-service architecture. Comfortable with high-availability concepts. Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+. Thoroughly experienced with React, SASS, Redux, build tools and the core principles surrounding these. Some backend experience to be able to run the app locally via NodeJS, with MongoDB, configuring ports and local environment Familiar with modern front-end pipelines and tools. Experienced with RESTful and RPC-based APIs. Interest in bringing diverse, innovative applications to life. Interest in modernising and optimising different web applications.Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels.We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:  Verify the recruiter's identity.All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you're unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods.We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. Double-check email addresses.All communication from us will come from emails ending in@ tether.Toor @ tether.Io We will never request payment or financial details.If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Esse cargo envolve o desenho e desenvolvimento de soluções para garantir a interoperabilidade da plataforma com os sistemas das operadoras de saúde, assegurando fluxo de dados com segurança e alta performance. Qualificações   Acima de 6 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software  Acima de 4 anos com Node.js e Type Script em produção  Acima de 4 anos com bancos relacionais (My SQL), incluindo modelagem e otimização  Experiência com arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, DDD) Experiência com cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) e mensageria (Rabbit MQ/Kafka) Experiência com APIs RESTful escaláveis  Experiência em ambientes de alta criticidade e alto volume de dados  Domínio de frameworks como Nest JS e/ou Next.js  Conhecimento em testes automatizados (TDD, unitários e integração) Habilidade para trabalho colaborativo  Visão sistêmica e entendimento do impacto técnico no produto  Comunicação assertiva com clientes e time interno  Autonomia para conduzir projetos complexos e gerenciar riscos  Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas com foco na causa raiz    Será um diferencial:    Experiência com PHP:  Temos legado e integrações onde esse conhecimento será muito útil para modernização;   Experiência na sustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Vivência com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, Git Hub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2).    Atribuições:   Interface Técnica com Clientes: Atuar como ponto focal em reuniões com os times de TI dos clientes (operadoras de saúde) para alinhar requisitos de integração, layouts de dados e especificações de API;  Gestão e Organização Técnica: Traduzir requisitos de negócio em tarefas técnicas claras, quebrando demandas complexas em entregáveis menores para orientar o trabalho dos desenvolvedores Juniors e Plenos;  Arquitetura e Design: Projetar e desenvolver soluções escaláveis, resilientes e de alta performance utilizando Node.js (Nest JS/Next.js);  Sustentação e Confiabilidade: Atuar na manutenção dos sistemas em produção, identificando, diagnosticando e corrigindo bugs e falhas (em sistemas, fontes de dados e APIs) de forma ágil para garantir a continuidade dos serviços;  Mentoria e Qualidade: Realizar Code Reviews rigorosos e disseminar boas práticas (Clean Code, SOLID), elevando a barra técnica da equipe;  Padronização e Performance: Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e identificar gargalos de performance em cenários de alto volume de dados.    O que oferecemos?  Modalidade Flexível: Híbrido ou 100% Remoto  Possibilidade de regime CLT ou PJ;  Se CLT, convênio com Bradesco Saúde e Cartão Flash (VR);  Ambiente colaborativo e desafiador;  Horários flexíveis;  Autonomia para propor e implementar novas tecnologias!

DiferenciaisExperiência Prática: Implementação comprovada de sistemas multiagente. Infraestrutura de Produção: Capacidade de construir e manter infraestrutura robusta de IA em ambientes de escala real. Plataforma de aprendizagem contínua (CI&T University). Plataforma online gratuita dedicada à promoção da saúde física, mental e bem-estar. Curso gestante e parentalidade responsável. Operational Support: - Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy. QUALIFICATIONS: - Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred. title: Product Manager (Senior/Lead) ID42374
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Product Manager (Senior/Lead) ID42374 em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media . WHAT YOU WILL DO  Product Strategy  – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives Product Leadership  – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products. Team Leadership  – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products. Product Roadmap  – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly. Cross-Functional Collaboration  – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery. User Research  – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements. User Experience (UX)  – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms. Data Analysis  – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product. Product Development  – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule. Project Management  – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap. Product Launch  – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback. Stakeholder Communication  – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals. Market and Competitive Analysis  – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market. User Feedback and Support  – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.  MUST HAVES - 5-7 years  working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;- Upper-Intermediate English level. NICE TO HAVES - Deep understanding of gaming trends;- Strong background in app development and design. PERKS AND BENEFITS - Professional growth:  Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.- Competitive compensation:  We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.- A selection of exciting projects:  Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.- Flextime:  Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: It operations analyst
description:

Company Overview BotCity is building the future of automation with the Governance Platform for Python automations and AI Agents. We empower enterprises to innovate at scale, bringing governance, control, and observability to every automation project. Our philosophy is simple: automation is software, and software deserves the same high‑code standards that drive innovation in AI and machine learning. We recently raised a $12M Series A, led by Four Rivers with participation from Y Combinator, SoftBank, and top industry leaders such as Lew Cirne (New Relic), Rod Johnson (Spring Source), and Walter Kortschak. With 1,000+ customers in 70+ countries, including Bayer and LG, and recognition by G2 (2024) as one of the world’s top 25 emerging platforms, BotCity is scaling fast. We’re a global remote company with teams across the US and LATAM, united by a shared vision to redefine how enterprises build and manage automation. Role Overview The ITOps Analyst will handle all IT operational needs at BotCity (excluding product, engineering, and InfoSec), covering tasks from user provisioning to device management to infrastructure support. This role is crucial to ensuring that internal teams (sales, ops, marketing, etc.) can operate without IT friction or downtime. The ideal person is a hands‑on problem‑solver with strong ownership, technical versatility, and clear communication. Responsibilities Manage user lifecycle, including provisioning, de‑provisioning, access controls, and permissions across systems (G Suite, Office 365, Slack, internal tools). Oversee hardware and software asset inventory, including acquisitions, deployments, refresh cycles, and warranties. Set up, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot workstations, peripherals, mobile devices, VPNs, and basic network connectivity. Troubleshoot and resolve user IT tickets (desktop, laptop, OS, connectivity, software) promptly. Coordinate with vendors for support, maintenance, and procurement (SaaS tools, licensing). Create, maintain and enforce internal IT policies and standards (passwords, device encryption, backup, patching). Support onboarding and off‑boarding processes with IT compliance (access removal, exit checklist). Monitor and manage internal systems (file shares, backup, printers, internal tools) and alert on issues. Create and maintain documentation of IT processes, configurations, user guides, and policies. Assist with small infrastructure projects (office moves, network upgrades, software rollouts). Escalate and coordinate with Engineering and Security teams when needed (e.g., deeper system issues).  Requisitos Technical diploma in Information Systems, Systems Analysis or related degree. Experience (3+ years) in an IT support, systems, or operations role (generalist). Strong experience with user and access management systems (e.g., Google Workspace, SSO, IAM). Experience with service management frameworks / ticketing systems (e.g., Zendesk, ServiceNow). Hands‑on experience with Windows / macOS workstations and standard corporate software stacks. Basic knowledge of network fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, TCP/IP) and troubleshooting. Familiarity with device management (MDM), patching, endpoint security. Experience with inventory / asset management systems. Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work autonomously. Good organizational skills and attention to detail. Experience working with MS Office/Excel, Google Suite, Notion, Slack. Ability to travel as needed to support events and meet the team. Portuguese – Fluent. English – Advanced.  Preferred Qualifications Exposure to basic scripting / automation (Shell, Python, PowerShell) to automate repetitive IT tasks. Exposure to security best practices (patch management, endpoint protection). Prior experience in an early‑stage, high‑growth, and fast‑paced startup environment or technology companies. title: Expert Engineer in Verification (UVM/IP/SoC)
description:

Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?  Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions. Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups. We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy. To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team. Your main responsibilities As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans. You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS). Is the job right for you? To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics: Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC, SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development, Development of verification plans, AMBA protocols, Embedded software development (C, C++), Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog, Written and spoken English.  Other skills welcome: Object Oriented Programming, Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, … ASIC and FPGA design, Scripting (Python).  For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to: Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification, Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism! Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions, Be able to work in a team, Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”, And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.  What we offer you Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials, Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion, Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work, Full time contract, Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.  Want to join us? Our recruitment process is simple:  After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director. If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director. Are you interested in the position?Find out more about us  #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Please note that this role works 100% on-site.  About us  AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa. About AB InBev Growth Group  Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world. In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft. We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities. About the Role  As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of ourecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user-centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions.You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end-users, and engineering,shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI. What you'll do:  Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption; Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows; Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture; Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions; Balance short-term feature delivery with long-term scalability and system health; Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements; Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator-friendly experiences; Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights; Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement; Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI-driven solutions across the product ecosystem; Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.  What you'll need:  University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience); Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains; Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements; Data-centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions; Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud-based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade-offs with engineers); Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams; Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products; Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence; Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows; Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business-focused.  More about you:  You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality; You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world; Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture; You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions; You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands; You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch. This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience. Springboard to a better life For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023. Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says. When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future. Between family life and programming Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew. Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation. “Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.” Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness. Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”  #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

Overview  About Nu Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 117 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company leads an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. Learn more:   People and Culture at Nubank  Our team works on identifying, attracting, reaching out, assessing, engaging, nurturing and hiring top-notch talent that can strengthen Nubank’s culture. We’re looking for a passionate, data-driven Senior Recruiter  to join our global Talent Acquisition team. You’ll play a critical role in helping us scale our product teams, identifying top-tier talent, and shaping an inclusive candidate experience across borders. You’ll work closely with business leaders, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners to drive full-cycle recruitment strategies and bring in exceptional talent that shares our mission and values. We are a process-light organization that values human interactions. We value working in small, independent teams that feel like small startups within the company, and eschew coupling and centralizing where realistic. We understand that execution is the key to success and optimize processes to remove bottlenecks.  Responsibilities   Own and drive full-cycle recruitment  Build strong, consultative partnerships with hiring managers, understanding their needs and advising on best hiring practices.  Source and engage passive candidates through creative channels and market research.  Deliver high-touch candidate experiences that reflect Nubank’s values of transparency, empathy, and simplicity.  Use data and metrics to inform recruiting strategies and continuously improve pipeline health and process efficiency.  Partner with employer branding, people analytics, and HR teams to align hiring efforts with business goals.    You Will Be a Great Fit If You Have   Experience in full-cycle recruiting, ideally in fast-paced, product-driven companies.  A strong understanding of the talent landscape, especially in Brazil and LATAM.  Demonstrated ability to manage multiple searches and stakeholders with a solutions-oriented approach.  Experience with sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, Gem, etc.).  Passion for candidate experience, inclusive hiring, and employer brand.  Advanced English is required; Spanish is a plus.    Nice To Have   Experience recruiting across multiple geographies and time zones.  Previous exposure to fintech or hypergrowth environments.    Why Nubank?   Purpose-driven work that impacts millions of people.  Collaborative and inclusive remote culture.  Competitive compensation and benefits package.  Learning and development support to grow your career.  Opportunity to help shape the future of financial services.    Benefits   Health, dental and life insurance  Meal allowance  Transportation assistance  30 days of paid vacation  Equity at Nubank  Parking partnership - discounted parking in our office  Free bike parking with showers available  NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program  NuLanguage - Our language learning program  Gympass partnership  Extended maternity and paternity Leaves  Child care allowance  Espaço Feijão - Private nursing and breastfeeding spaces in our buildings  Onsite Health Center - Medical support for every Nubanker in our office    Our Nu Way of Working  Our work model is hybrid and has cycles that can be from two to three months according to the business of expertise. For every eight or twelve weeks of remote work, one will be at the office. Check more information here.  Diversity & Inclusion  At Nu, we want to be sure that we're building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. We hire based on equality and consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company while ensuring none of them represent a barrier when recruiting talented individuals.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi  Viver pelo cliente  – Nosso principal ativo são os clientes. A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado.  Agir como empreendedor  – Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.  Crescer na jornada  – Nossa cultura é forte. Só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.  Modelo de trabalho   Presencial – Campinas/SP    Nosso time de Dados  São os times responsáveis por definir quando a contratação de um crédito será boa para o cliente e para o Agibank, buscando o sucesso e sustentabilidade de ambos no longo prazo. Apoiam ativamente a prevenção de fraudes, com estratégias inteligentes. O time de Dados, utilizando tecnologia e visão de futuro, sustenta decisões assertivas e eficientes.  Seus desafios para crescer na jornada   Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning para resolver problemas complexos com impacto para o negócio.  Realizar exploração, limpeza e preparação de dados para estudos analíticos.  Criar relatórios que traduzam resultados técnicos em insights para as áreas de negócio.  Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para formular hipóteses, entender as necessidades, avaliar a aplicação dos modelos nas estratégias, testar soluções e acompanhar resultados.  Garantir a qualidade, integridade e governança dos dados utilizados nos projetos analíticos.    O que você precisa para se tornar um Agilizado?  Requisitos    Experiência com linguagens de programação como Python ou R.  Domínio de algoritmos clássicos e modernos de aprendizado de máquina, como árvores de decisão, regressão logística, ensemble e boosting models (ex.: XGBoost, LightGBM, catboost).  Forte base em estatística, probabilidade e modelagem preditiva.  Vivência com manipulação e tratamento de grandes volumes de dados (SQL, Spark).    Diferenciais    Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing (AWS, GCP ou Azure).  Conhecimento de modelagem de crédito (indicadores, estratégias, técnicas).  Experiência com modelos de risco de crédito (PD, LGD, EAD).  Familiaridade com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau ou similares).  Conhecimento em práticas de MLOps e deploy de modelos em produção.  Experiência ou interesse em projetos de IA generativa, NLP (Processamento de Linguagem Natural) ou modelos de grandes linguagens (LLMs).  Conhecimento de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git) e integração contínua.    Benefícios e facilidades   Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, teleatendimento psicológico e médico gratuito, Totalpass, vale-refeição e alimentação e seguro de vida/auxílio-funeral.  Maternidade e paternidade: auxílio-creche, licença-maternidade de 6 meses, licença-paternidade de 20 dias, VA/VR no período da licença.  Previdência privada.  Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) seguindo as regras estabelecidas anualmente.  Vale-transporte.  Fretado de ida e volta para Campinas e região (com raio de até 50 km de distância). São lugares reserváveis mediante a disponibilidade de assentos e rota. Para quem vai de carro, temos estacionamento gratuito.  Folga de presente no mês do seu aniversário.  Dinheiro de volta no Cartão de Crédito: 1% de cashback sobre o valor total da fatura do cartão revertido em crédito na fatura seguinte.  Conta remunerada: CDB de aplicação automática e rendimento de 100% do CDI.  Isenção de tarifas de comunicação digital.  Crédito do Trabalhador: taxa e prazo diferenciados. Disponível para contratação a partir de 6 meses de casa.  Antecipação saque aniversário do FGTS.  Dr. Pet: possibilidade de fazer plano de saúde para pets com até 20% de desconto.    Programa Tô de dono  O Tô de Dono é mais do que um programa de incentivo a longo prazo – ele é o reconhecimento de quem vive diariamente a nossa cultura. A cada ano, o Programa tem novos participantes, colaboradores que se tornam donos do negócio e ganham com a valorização do Agibank sempre que a empresa cresce. Então, quem faz parte dessa história é quem mergulha de cabeça nos desafios para entregar grandes resultados. É assim que construímos, verdadeiramente, uma cultura de donos. Aqui, a fórmula é simples: você cresce. O Agibank cresce com você.  Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no LinkedIn e Youtube  Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor.   #J-18808-Ljbffr
